mass_note: Mass of the solid mesh in PLA (1.24 g/cm3): an upper bound, a print with 20 to 30 % infill weighs much less.

parts.name: Tray, right
parts.role: The case body: angular walls on the stepped PCB outline, key floor 3 mm under the PCB, battery well, controller box walls, five standoffs for M2 heat-set inserts, four foot magnet pockets from below. Carries the pocket for the trackball cradle.
parts.print_notes: PETG or PLA, 0.2 mm layers, 3 perimeters, 20 % infill, no supports. Flat on the bed, cavities open upwards; the only bridges are the USB opening (11 mm), the switch slot, the LED window and the magnet pockets.

parts.name: Controller box cap, right
parts.role: Roof of the controller box: a 2 mm plate in the rebate plus an L-shaped skirt towards the keys and the thumb keys, held by two M2 screws in the corner bosses. The wordmark is engraved 0.6 mm into the plate.

parts.print_notes: 0.12 mm layers, otherwise as the tray. Print it with the cradle and a scrap PCB with the notch before the full tray.

parts.name: Cradle, 19.05 mm ball, pocket
parts.role: The r2 default: cup with three static ceramic bearings for a 19.05 mm ball and the housing for the PMW3610 sensor board, standing on the case floor in the pocket beside the right PCB.
